evidence.detail: R303 GameSceneRenderer invokes rs/l/b/b.a(Client) after world-scene/camera rendering, fixing rs/l/b/b as the post-scene HUD/gameframe composition phase.
The class repeatedly calls Client.a(int,int,rs/n/e,int), whose R302 authority delegates into InterfaceRenderer, to place active root/gameframe interfaces at resolved screen positions.
It renders exact client HUD/debug strings including 'RUNTIME INFORMATION', 'COORDINATE INFORMATION', FPS, memory, ping, mouse coordinates, region id and interface/item debug state.
It renders system-update warning/countdown presentation, tournament/lobby status such as 'Waiting for more players' and 'Tournament starts in:', plus other live gameframe status surfaces.
The same post-scene pass advances exact presentation managers including hit-drop/pop-up state and the retained scrolling/sliding text manager before returning to GameSceneRenderer.
